comment: One push = one experiment. Every variant is a CI job of its own: its own simulator, its 'run' lines (exe + args, run one after the other), 'env' (exported to the harness as SIMCTL_CHILD_*), 'cfg_preset' (a GameRecommendations.swift id: that game's madeira.cfg as a device applies it) and 'cfg' (lines after it), 'timeout' (seconds per run line, default 240), and 'ersc' (a key of ersc_builds, downloaded to system32/ersc.dll). See README.md. 'pe_release': a release tag whose Madeira.ipa supplies 'pe_files' (default ntdll.dll and xtajit64.dll) instead of this checkout's. 'ntdll': a key of 'ntdll_builds', each an ntdll.dll built in CI from build/wine-pe/patches ('patches': the name prefixes to keep; absent = all) plus wine-patches/.
